column1: # ZAP baseline rules for the NeuroPause backend API (NP-RELEASE-043 §13).
# Target is the JSON API started in CI (security-ci.yml dast job) — no HTML UI,
# no cookies (bearer-token auth), TLS terminated by the edge in production.
# FAIL = must hold on the API; a regression fails the workflow.
#   10021: helmet() sets X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff on every response.
# WARN = reported, not gating, each with a reason:
#   10010/10011: cookie flags — the API sets no cookies (bearer tokens only).
#   10015/10049: cache-control on JSON responses — informational for an API.
#   10017/10098: cross-domain script/CORS — CORS is locked to loopback origins
#                in app.ts; ZAP's generic heuristic cannot see the regex origin.
#   10020: X-Frame-Options — helmet sets frameguard; JSON responses are not
#          frameable content. Kept WARN to surface any change.
#   10038/10055: CSP — helmet sets a default CSP; an API serves no scripts.
#   10063: Permissions-Policy — not applicable to a JSON API.
